senses.en: to ask about something (mainly British English)

example.en: She enquired about train times at the desk.
example.zh: 她在服务台询问了火车时刻。

senses.en: to officially investigate a matter

example.en: A committee was set up to enquire into the accident.
example.zh: 成立了一个委员会来调查这起事故。

senses.en: coming next after seventy-nine in order; ordinal of eighty

example.en: The town celebrated its eightieth anniversary last year.
example.zh: 该镇去年庆祝了建镇八十周年。

senses.en: one of eighty equal parts

example.en: Each share represented an eightieth of the total estate.
example.zh: 每份股份代表总遗产的八十分之一。

senses.en: lively, energetic quickness of manner or movement

example.en: She greeted customers with cheerful briskness.
example.zh: 她以爽快的劲头招呼顾客。

senses.en: (mainly North American) rooms or places for travelers to stay in

example.en: Hotel accommodations in the city are expensive during the summer.
example.zh: 夏季城里的酒店住宿很贵。

senses.en: adjustments made to suit circumstances or people's needs

example.en: The school provides accommodations for students with special needs.
example.zh: 学校为有特殊需要的学生提供便利安排。

senses.en: completed; done

example.en: The report is finished and ready to send.
example.zh: 报告已完成，可以发送了。

senses.en: made to a high standard of polish or quality

example.en: The furniture has a beautifully finished surface.
example.zh: 这件家具有一个非常精美光滑的表面。

senses.en: to secretly access or manipulate a computer system or account
senses.zh: 非法侵入（计算机系统）；窃取（数据）

example.en: Someone tried to hack into her email account.
example.zh: 有人试图入侵她的电子邮箱账户。

senses.en: to cut something roughly with heavy blows

example.en: He hacked at the thick bushes with a machete.
example.zh: 他用砍刀猛砍茂密的灌木丛。

senses.en: to manage or cope with something (informal, often with 'can')
senses.zh: 应付；应付得了（非正式，常与can连用）

example.en: I just can't hack the pressure of this job anymore.
example.zh: 我再也应付不了这份工作的压力了。

senses.en: a quick solution or clever trick to solve a problem

example.en: Here's a useful life hack for organizing your kitchen.
example.zh: 这里有一个整理厨房的实用生活小窍门。

senses.en: a substance used to make the body or face more beautiful

example.en: She works for a large cosmetics company.
example.zh: 她在一家大型化妆品公司工作。

senses.en: improving appearance but not changing real substance; superficial

example.en: The repairs to the bridge were purely cosmetic.
example.zh: 对大桥的修缮纯粹是表面功夫。

senses.en: relating to cosmetics or intended to improve appearance

example.en: She is considering cosmetic surgery to remove the scar.
example.zh: 她正在考虑做去除疤痕的美容手术。

senses.en: covered or filled with mist; not clear

example.en: The valley looked misty in the early morning.
example.zh: 清晨的山谷笼罩在薄雾之中。

senses.en: the act of returning home after a long absence

example.en: Her homecoming after ten years abroad was emotional.
example.zh: 旅居十年后回乡，她百感交集。

senses.en: an annual celebration and reunion at a school or university, especially in North America

example.en: The football game is a tradition of homecoming weekend.
example.zh: 橄榄球赛是返校节周末的传统活动。

senses.en: a long hollow object used to hold or carry liquids, gases, or other things

example.en: Water flows through the plastic tube.
example.zh: 水流过这根塑料管。

senses.en: the underground railway system in London

example.en: She takes the Tube to work every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上乘伦敦地铁上班。

senses.en: a soft container with a cap, used for paste or cream

example.en: He squeezed the last bit of toothpaste from the tube.
example.zh: 他从软管里挤出最后一点牙膏。

senses.en: relating to genes or heredity
senses.zh: 遗传的；与基因或遗传有关的

example.en: The disease has a genetic cause.
example.zh: 这种疾病有遗传原因。

senses.en: relating to the study of genes

example.en: She works in a genetic research laboratory.
example.zh: 她在一个遗传学研究实验室工作。

senses.en: having drunk too much alcohol and being affected by it

example.en: He was too drunk to drive home.
example.zh: 他醉得开不了车回家。

senses.en: a person who is drunk or often drinks too much alcohol

example.en: The bar was full of noisy drunks.
example.zh: 酒吧里挤满了吵闹的醉汉。

senses.en: a formal talk given to an audience

example.en: She gave a short speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 她在仪式上作了简短的讲话。

senses.en: the ability to speak or the act of speaking

example.en: The stroke affected his speech.
example.zh: 中风影响了他的言语能力。

senses.en: spoken language or a way of speaking

example.en: Her speech was clear and calm.
example.zh: 她说话清晰而平静。

senses.en: able to do many different things well

example.en: She is a versatile actress who can play comedy and drama.
example.zh: 她是一位多才多艺的演员，既能演喜剧也能演正剧。

senses.en: having many different uses

example.en: This is a versatile tool that can be used in the kitchen and workshop.
example.zh: 这是一件用途广泛的工具，厨房和车间都能用。

senses.en: to think that something is wrong or not good

example.en: Her parents disapprove of her staying out late.
example.zh: 她的父母不赞成她在外待得太晚。

senses.en: a female given name

example.en: Caroline is studying French at university.
example.zh: 卡罗琳正在大学学习法语。

senses.en: relating to the reigns of Charles I or Charles II of England
senses.zh: （英国）查理一世或查理二世时代的

example.en: The museum displays Caroline-era portraits.
example.zh: 这家博物馆展出查理时代的肖像画。

senses.en: in a way that is correct and exact

example.en: She accurately described what had happened.
example.zh: 她准确地描述了发生的事情。

senses.en: a strong physical or psychological need for a substance or activity

example.en: Drug addiction can seriously damage a person's health.
example.zh: 毒瘾会严重损害一个人的健康。

senses.en: continuing for a long time without becoming weaker

example.en: The region needs sustained economic growth to reduce poverty.
example.zh: 该地区需要持续的经济增长来减少贫困。

senses.en: to develop industry in a country or region, especially manufacturing on a large scale

example.en: The country industrialized rapidly in the twentieth century.
example.zh: 该国在二十世纪迅速实现了工业化。

senses.en: the seventh month of the year, after June and before August

example.en: We usually go to the beach in July.
example.zh: 我们通常七月去海滩。

senses.en: a common male given name

example.en: George is coming to the party tonight.
example.zh: 乔治今晚要来参加聚会。

senses.en: Saint George, the patron saint of England, famous for the legend of slaying a dragon
senses.zh: 圣乔治（英格兰主保圣人，传说中屠龙英雄）

example.en: Saint George is the patron saint of England.
example.zh: 圣乔治是英格兰的主保圣人。

senses.en: a small community of homes in the countryside, smaller than a town

example.en: She grew up in a small village near the mountains.
example.zh: 她在山区附近的一个小村庄长大。

senses.en: lacking knowledge or information about something

example.en: The public remained uninformed about the plan.
example.zh: 公众对这项计划仍不了解。

senses.en: a game or group of games played on a cloth-covered table by striking balls with cues

example.en: They played billiards at the club after work.
example.zh: 下班后他们在俱乐部打台球。

senses.en: a short piece of writing that describes a scene or character briefly
senses.zh: 小品文；简短的描写片段

example.en: The book is a collection of vignettes about village life.
example.zh: 这本书是关于乡村生活的小品文集。

senses.en: a picture or photo with edges that gradually fade into the background

example.en: The photographer added a soft vignette around the portrait.
example.zh: 摄影师在肖像周围加上了柔和的晕影。

senses.en: to leave an item as security for borrowed money

example.en: He had to pawn his watch to pay the rent.
example.zh: 他不得不典当手表来付房租。

senses.en: an item left as security, or a chess piece

example.en: He moved a pawn forward at the start of the game.
example.zh: 开局时他把一个兵向前走了一步。

senses.en: a person used by others for their own ends

example.en: He realized he was just a pawn in their plan.
example.zh: 他意识到自己只是他们计划中的一个棋子。

senses.en: a strong keen desire or enthusiasm for something

example.en: The children showed great eagerness to open their presents.
example.zh: 孩子们急切地想打开礼物。

senses.en: solid waste from animals, sometimes used as fertilizer

example.en: Farmers spread dung over the fields to enrich the soil.
example.zh: 农民把粪肥撒在田里以肥沃土壤。

senses.en: to fertilize land with animal waste

example.en: They dunged the vegetable plots before planting.
example.zh: 他们种植前给菜地施了粪肥。

senses.en: made from standardized separate units that can be combined or replaced easily

example.en: The company builds modular furniture that customers can rearrange.
example.zh: 该公司生产客户可以重新组合的模块化家具。

senses.en: a person or machine that twists fibers into thread

example.en: The spinner worked the wool into fine yarn.
example.zh: 纺纱工把羊毛纺成了细纱线。

senses.en: a pointer on a dial that is spun to determine a move in a board game

example.en: Give the spinner a spin to see how many spaces you move.
example.zh: 转动转盘指针，看看你能走几格。

senses.en: the short thick finger on the side of your hand

example.en: She hurt her thumb while opening the jar.
example.zh: 她开罐子时伤到了拇指。

senses.en: to press or operate something with your thumb

example.en: He thumbed the button to open the door.
example.zh: 他用拇指按下按钮开门。

senses.en: to turn pages quickly with your thumb

example.en: She thumbed through the magazine at the dentist's office.
example.zh: 她在牙医诊所里快速翻阅杂志。

senses.en: to hitchhike by signaling for a ride

example.en: They thumbed a ride to the next town.
example.zh: 他们搭便车去了下一个镇。

senses.en: a piece of cloth hung over a window to block light or give privacy

example.en: She pulled the curtains to keep out the morning sun.
example.zh: 她拉上窗帘挡住早晨的阳光。

senses.en: a large screen at the front of a stage

example.en: The curtain rose and the play began.
example.zh: 幕布升起，戏剧开始了。

senses.en: to cover or hide something with a curtain

example.en: He curtained off the corner to make a small dressing area.
example.zh: 他用帘子把角落隔开，做了一个小更衣区。

senses.en: the space above the earth where clouds and the sun appear

example.en: The sky turned pink at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空变成了粉红色。

senses.en: to hit a ball very high into the air

example.en: He skied his shot over the goal.
example.zh: 他一脚把球踢得很高，越过了球门。

senses.en: a person who carries a message from one place or person to another

example.en: The messenger delivered the letter to the office that morning.
example.zh: 那天上午，信使把信送到了办公室。

senses.en: a solid or container with a circular cross-section and straight parallel sides

example.en: The column was shaped like a cylinder.
example.zh: 那根柱子呈圆柱形。

senses.en: the chamber in an engine in which a piston moves

example.en: The engine has six cylinders.
example.zh: 这台发动机有六个汽缸。

senses.en: using or showing careful logical analysis; good at examining things in detail

example.en: She has an analytical mind and solves problems quickly.
example.zh: 她头脑善于分析，解决问题很快。

senses.en: relating to the use of scientific methods to separate and examine the parts of a substance

example.en: The lab uses analytical chemistry to test water samples.
example.zh: 实验室用分析化学检测水样。

senses.en: to make something tight or tighter

example.en: He tightened the screws on the chair.
example.zh: 他把椅子上的螺丝拧紧了。

senses.en: to become tight or tighter

example.en: Her muscles tightened as she waited for the result.
example.zh: 等待结果时她的肌肉绷紧了。

senses.en: an elastic material made from tree latex or synthetically

example.en: The tires are made of rubber.
example.zh: 这些轮胎是橡胶做的。

senses.en: an eraser used to remove pencil marks (British English)

example.en: Can I borrow your rubber to erase this mistake?
example.zh: 我能借你的橡皮擦掉这个错误吗？

senses.en: a waterproof overshoe (often in the plural, mainly American English)
senses.zh: 胶鞋；雨鞋（常用复数，主要为美式英语）

example.en: He put on his rubbers before walking through the wet grass.
example.zh: 他穿上胶鞋才走过湿草地。

senses.en: having good luck; lucky

example.en: She was fortunate to find a job quickly.
example.zh: 她很幸运，很快就找到了工作。

senses.en: to show or make something clear through actions or signs

example.en: Stress often manifests itself as headaches or trouble sleeping.
example.zh: 压力常常表现为头痛或睡眠问题。

senses.en: clear and obvious; easily seen or understood

example.en: There was a manifest improvement in her English after months of practice.
example.zh: 经过几个月的练习，她的英语明显提高了。

senses.en: a document listing the cargo or passengers on a ship or plane
senses.zh: （船或飞机的）载货单；乘客名单

example.en: The customs officer checked the ship's manifest before allowing the cargo to be unloaded.
example.zh: 海关官员在允许卸货前检查了这艘船的载货单。

senses.en: the freedom to decide how to act or judge on one's own

example.en: Managers have the discretion to approve small expenses.
example.zh: 经理有权自行批准小额开支。

senses.en: careful behavior that avoids embarrassing or upsetting others; being careful and tactful

example.en: Please use discretion when discussing the matter.
example.zh: 谈论此事时请务必谨慎。

senses.en: to enjoy a taste or experience slowly and fully

example.en: He savored every bite of the meal.
example.zh: 他细细品味着每一口饭菜。

senses.en: the taste or smell of something; flavor

example.en: The dish had the savor of fresh herbs.
example.zh: 这道菜带有新鲜香草的风味。

senses.en: (formal, usually with of) to have a particular taste or suggest a quality

example.en: The soup savored of smoke from the fire.
example.zh: 汤里带有柴火烟熏的味道。

senses.en: to respect and admire someone or something very deeply

example.en: Many people revere the founder of the company.
example.zh: 许多人崇敬这家公司的创始人。

senses.en: the inability to produce offspring

example.en: The couple sought medical advice about their sterility.
example.zh: 这对夫妇就他们的不孕问题寻求医疗建议。

senses.en: the state of being free from living microorganisms

example.en: Surgical instruments must be checked for sterility before use.
example.zh: 手术器械使用前必须检查是否无菌。

senses.en: lack of originality or vitality

example.en: Critics complained about the sterility of the novel's prose.
example.zh: 评论家抱怨这部小说的文笔空洞乏味。

senses.en: relating to the sounds of speech

example.en: The dictionary gives a phonetic transcription of each word.
example.zh: 这部词典为每个单词标注了音标。

senses.en: toward home

example.en: After the long journey, we finally turned homeward.
example.zh: 长途旅行结束后，我们终于踏上归途。

senses.en: going or pointing toward home

example.en: She waved to her friends on the homeward train.
example.zh: 她在返程的火车上向朋友们挥手。

senses.en: willing to help and do favors for others

example.en: The hotel staff were very obliging and arranged a taxi for us.
example.zh: 酒店员工非常热心，还帮我们安排了出租车。

senses.en: a soft thick fabric made by pressing fibers together

example.en: The children cut shapes out of colored felt.
example.zh: 孩子们从彩色毛毡上剪出各种形状。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of feel; to experience an emotion or sensation
senses.zh: 感觉（feel 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: She felt happy when she saw her friends.
example.zh: 见到朋友们时她感到很开心。

senses.en: able to move quickly and easily

example.en: The cat is very agile and climbs trees easily.
example.zh: 这只猫非常敏捷，爬树毫不费力。

senses.en: able to think quickly and clearly

example.en: She has an agile mind and solves problems fast.
example.zh: 她思维敏捷，解决问题很快。

senses.en: showing great care and attention to detail
senses.zh: 极其仔细的；煞费苦心的

example.en: The restoration required painstaking work on every detail.
example.zh: 修复工作需要对每个细节都格外用心。

senses.en: the art of designing and arranging dance movements

example.en: The choreography of the musical was praised by critics.
example.zh: 这部音乐剧的编舞受到了评论家的赞扬。

senses.en: present participle of accelerate: to move or happen faster

example.en: The car is accelerating rapidly on the highway.
example.zh: 汽车在高速公路上迅速加速。

senses.en: increasing in speed or rate

example.en: The economy shows accelerating inflation.
example.zh: 经济显示出不断加快的通货膨胀。

senses.en: (informal, disapproving) describing a husband as constantly criticized or controlled by his wife
senses.zh: （口语，贬义）被妻子不断数落或管束的；惧内的

example.en: He plays the henpecked husband in the comedy.
example.zh: 他在那部喜剧里扮演一个怕老婆的丈夫。

senses.en: skill in managing a household, such as cooking and housekeeping

example.en: The course taught basic housecraft like cooking and budgeting.
example.zh: 这门课程讲授烹饪和理财等基本家政技能。
